writeup: Tilswall's GLPPSA11 paint sprayer prep kit is $18.99 new on Woot, with only one left at last check and a three-per-customer limit. It bundles 20 strainers rated 190 micron, two pre-taped masking paper rolls and two 50m tape rolls in 24mm and 48mm widths. Tilswall's own store sells the same SKU for $59.99 in stock, so this is about 68% below that live price.
